proofs.text: Retag the rule `[risk: medium]`, run the tests and write a record, then build the brief; verify its layers are `proof text`, `test body`, `test strength` and nothing after

rule_text: A medium-risk rule's brief adds the test strength layer and stops there

tests.body:
def test_medium_risk_stops_after_the_test_strength(self):
        made = Project(spec=SPEC.replace('[risk: high]', '[risk: medium]'))
        try:
            made.proofs()
            made.record()
            assert build(made, 'RULE-2')['layers'] == [
                'proof text', 'test body', 'test strength']
        finally:
            made.close()
tests.name: test_medium_risk_stops_after_the_test_strength
